correctness.rationale: An independent reconstruction of the finite regularity criterion and exact eigenvector/spectral inequalities bounds the count from both sides to O(log n) in logarithm. A central-start random-walk argument bounds all endomorphisms to polynomial accuracy. Uniform asymptotic minimization yields the \(\frac32\pi^{2/3}(\log2)^{2/3}\) constant. Brute-force semigroup witnesses match the criterion through \(n=7\), and every endomorphism is enumerated through \(n=12\); these are corroborations, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Regular elements are intrinsic to transformation semigroup structure. Their asymptotic proportion in the canonical path endomorphism monoid is a naturally motivated exact logarithmic invariant. The nontrivial cubic-root balancing law distinguishes long-run image traversal from spectral confinement, provides an explicit universal constant, and applies to an unbounded family; it is not a relabeled finite table or routine increment.
